summary: Frontend-only test of POIESIZ SHFT-style redesign. Verified Hero, pinned Process (how-section), horizontal filmstrip Projects, closing Contact/Centres section, Project Detail, Price Calculator and mobile layouts. Submitted consultation form end-to-end (enquiry toast + success state shown). All required data-testids are present and the SHFT-like motion (sticky steps, horizontal projects track, revealed big headline) is functional.

ui_bugs.issue: React 'duplicate key' warning when seeded phones array has two identical numbers (default seed has '+91 00000 00000' twice). key={p} should be key={`${p}-${i}`} or use index as fallback.

Both desktop (hidden md:block) and mobile (md:hidden) subtrees are mounted, so data-testid 'projects-title' and every 'projects-filter-*' id appear twice in the DOM at the same time (count=2). Works visually due to CSS, but duplicate test ids reduce test determinism.

action_items: Fix duplicate React key in Centres.jsx phone list (use index-based key).
Consider conditionally rendering only one of the desktop/mobile Projects subtrees (or scope testids) to avoid duplicate data-testid='projects-title' / 'projects-filter-*' nodes.
(Not tested) Admin edits on 'How it works' per-step photo/outcome and 'Contact details' kicker/closing fields — main agent can self-verify via admin UI.
critical_code_review_comments: Centres.jsx:38 uses phone string as React key which breaks when phones repeat.
Projects.jsx renders both desktop and mobile sections unconditionally; duplicate data-testid='projects-title' and projects-filter-* ids make it harder for tests to target a specific instance.
ProjectDetail slug for apostrophes produces '-s-' segment (e.g. actor-indrajith-sukumaran-s-residence). Works but visually odd; consider stripping apostrophes before slugifying.
test_credentials: admin@poiesizinteriors.com / Poiesiz@2e9955 (not used in this run)
seed_data_creation: Submitted 1 consultation enquiry as TEST_User_<timestamp> via public form at /#consult. No DB admin cleanup performed (public form, no exposed delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Default content (9 projects) only renders when /api/content lacks a 'projects' key. In live app it has 1 real project ('Actor Indrajith Sukumaran's Residence' -> slug 'actor-indrajith-sukumaran-s-residence'). To test filmstrip horizontal motion, intercept /api/content and delete 'projects'. The how-counter advances 01->04 only when scrolling with mouse.wheel (Lenis smooth scroll); window.scrollTo + small waits doesn't trigger the framer scroll progress, use page.mouse.wheel with small steps. Projects track x went 0 -> -3925 confirming horizontal filmstrip. Full-page intro curtain lasts ~3s on first load per session — wait 4-5s after goto.
